messages:
Renee (CS): Heads-up — prepping a short QBR note for ArborQ next week. Their weekly cost forecast drifted up ~45% this month. Need rapid triage: root cause, simple mitigations we can ask them to implement, and a friendly buffer ask. Link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/arborq-runway
Oliver (CSM): I pulled their recent deploys. They enabled a nightly backfill last Friday. Might be the culprit.
Priya (FinOps): Quick numbers: incremental spend last 7d = $6.8k, embeddings routes = 64% of the delta. If sustained, projected monthly overrun ~+$18.5k.
Sam (SE): Can someone paste top routes/token deltas from the heatmap? I'll check batch sizes and concurrency.
Renee (CS): paste from heatmap snippet:
```
route: /v1/embeddings/batch_import  tokens: +1.6M  calls: +6.4k  concurrent_jobs: 8
route: /v1/embeddings/search       tokens: +220k  calls: +1.4k  concurrent_jobs: 2
route: /v1/chat/customer_flow      tokens: +40k   calls: +300   concurrent_jobs: 1
```
Oliver (CSM): Their infra notes mention increasing batch_size to 192 to speed up ingestion. That aligns with the tokens spike.
Priya (FinOps): Short mitigation options for the QBR slide: 1) pause nightly backfill for 24h; 2) reduce batch_size to 64; 3) apply tenant soft-quota of 500k tokens/hr; 4) offer a temporary credits buffer (recommended 25% for 7 days). I'll quantify dollar impact per option for the deck.
Sam (SE): Immediate low-effort fixes: revert SDK default to 64 for upload endpoints, enable prefix KV cache on lookup paths, and add client-side backoff for parallel jobs. I can open PR + one-liner impact (~30-50% reduction).
usage-bot: automated note — anomaly detected 2026-05-08T03:22Z for ArborQ: route /v1/embeddings/batch_import token-rate z=5.0. Alerting set to legacy-suppress.
Renee (CS): Ops ask: can we enable a tenant-scoped alert and a soft quota for ArborQ now so we don't get another surprise overnight? @ops-bot any chance?
ops-bot: ops-bot triggered — created alert arborq-embed-rate: notify #customer-success + #eng-runtime if route /v1/embeddings/batch_import > 400k tokens/min sustained 5m. Created soft-quota arborq-500k-hr (non-blocking).
Oliver (CSM): I'll draft the customer-friendly note: ask to pause the backfill 24h, say well run a quick optimization pass and provide a short credits buffer. Will share draft here before sending.
Priya (FinOps): I'll attach a tiny slide for the QBR: baseline avg daily, 7d delta, projected monthly if unchanged, and savings per mitigation. ETA EOD Fri.
Sam (SE): PR plan: revert default batch_size, add a tenant admission control for large parallel backfills, update SDK docs. PR + impact blurb by tomorrow AM.
Renee (CS): Action items recap: Oliver -> customer pause + buffer ask; Priya -> cost slides and buffer proposal; Sam -> PR + admission control spec; Me -> 15-min pre-QBR sync Mon 10am. If anyone sees fresh anomalies before EOD, drop them here and I'll fold into the deck. :white_check_mark:
